claim: A trained 4B verifier gating step-level candidate sampling raises SWE-Bench Verified resolve from 75.47% to 77.20% at 1.09x cost on MiniMax-M2.7, verifying 3.43% of steps.
stance_target: score-gated selective compute is a competitive verification strategy
quoted_support: Table 1: MiniMax-M2.7 None 75.47+-1.40 at 1.00x; Selective Two-Stage Rubric 77.20+-0.87 at 1.09x (3.43% verified).

breadth.confidence_families: trained generative verifier score (Qwen3.5-4B student) used as gate; not a confidence/probability of correctness; no probes or verbal confidence (Sec 3.1)
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: policies MiniMax-M2.7 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash; verifier Qwen3.5-4B (Sec 4.1)
breadth.base_vs_instruct: not present (Untrained = base Qwen3.5-4B as ablation only)
breadth.post_training_stages: verifier fine-tuned on 30k action labels from 6,000 steps with GPT-5.6 teacher scores (Sec 3.3)
breadth.elicitation_formats: verifier score threshold (0.2 for DeepSeek) triggers candidate sampling (Sec 4.2)
breadth.benchmarks: SWE-Bench Verified 500 tasks, 202-task subset for tuning (Sec 4.1)
breadth.label_independence: verifier trained on teacher-scored preferences with observed environment outcomes; resolve labels separate
breadth.calibration_metrics: not present (searched: ECE, AUROC, calibration beyond prompt wording); metrics are resolve %, steps, cost multiple
breadth.causal_intervention: gate vs selector ablations (Table 2); threshold sweep (Fig 3); no hidden-state intervention

claim: Generalization to DeepSeek-V4-Flash: 72.60% to 74.27% at 1.13x cost with a threshold of 0.2 fixed without per-variant tuning.
quoted_support: DeepSeek-V4-Flash None 72.60+-0.53; Two-Stage Rubric 74.27+-1.01 at 1.13x; Oracle@3 80.60.

claim: The routing signal is a trained verifier preference score, not an elicited or probed confidence, and no random-routing baseline at matched verify rate is reported in Table 1.
stance_target: L3 occupancy: confidence-routed budget vs random and oracle routing
scope_conditions: Table 1 baselines: none, trajectory, all-step, selective, Oracle@3
quoted_support: Trajectory verification ... Oracle@3 gives an upper bound by selecting a successful rollout whenever one exists.
